name: POST /api/admin/voice-agent/calls/:call_id/carrier-call - Record an AI call's carrier CallSid
description: Operator-only (x-admin-ops-token), called by the voice runtime once an AI call's SIP leg exists: records the carrier's call id (Twilio CallSid) on voice_agent.call so carrier status callbacks can be applied to the AI call (506bbf30-2d83-440b-a853-1a8205f4b3cb#AC3), and links any Twilio mirror row with that CallSid (mirror_rows_linked). Idempotent for the same CallSid; a different CallSid on the call, or a CallSid already owned by another call, is 409. Runs across tenants by design (the runtime is not a tenant), so it is never reachable with a tenant credential.

testCases.name: Link a CallSid to the test-session call

errorCases.message: carrier_call_sid must be the carrier call id (e.g. a Twilio CallSid)

errorCases.when: no AI call with that id

errorCases.message: the call already has a different carrier call id
errorCases.when: a different CallSid is already recorded, or the CallSid belongs to another call
missing or invalid x-admin-ops-token (a tenant JWT is not accepted)
